topic: AI tool tutorial: ChatGPT Slides, turning chats and files into decks you can export
post:
ChatGPT can now build your slide deck, and your team can edit it with you. 📊
Here's how ChatGPT Slides works, in 60 seconds.

OpenAI started rolling out Slides last week. It lives in Space, ChatGPT's shared workspace.

Who gets it 👇
✅ Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access
🖥️ On the web and in the desktop app
⏳ Rolling out gradually, so it may not show up for everyone yet

How to use it 👇
1️⃣ Start from what you already have: a chat, uploaded files, an outline, or an example deck
2️⃣ Let ChatGPT draft the slides
3️⃣ Invite teammates to co-edit in real time and leave comments
4️⃣ Export from the web to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides

My tip: start from an outline you wrote yourself. You keep control of the story, and AI handles the layout.

Why it matters:
Decks are where a lot of office hours disappear. Every big AI assistant now wants to own that "blank slide" moment. 🔍

Practical takeaway:
Before you share an AI deck, check every number and name against your source. It's your name on the presentation. ✍️

Would you trust AI with your next big presentation? 👇
